# Copper chestplate

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing)

<a href="Item-copper-chestplate.md" title="Copper chestplate"><img src="icons/71.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Copper chestplate"></a>

Equip in the chest armor slot to add 5 protection points. The equipped piece appears on your explorer and the inventory portrait. Armor reduces incoming damage and currently has no durability loss.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 1 |
| Armor protection | 5 points |

## How to obtain

Make this item using the crafting or processing recipes below.
